requirements.summary: Add a client-side search bar that filters FAQ items by query text.
acceptanceCriteria: FAQ page shows a visible search input near the top of the FAQ content (under the title/intro).
Typing a query filters FAQ entries in-place without navigating away or requiring authentication.
Search matches against the question text and answer text (case-insensitive).
When the search box is empty, the full original FAQ content is shown (no content loss).

file_operations.description: Implement local query state and in-place filtering for the FAQ list by matching the query (case-insensitive) against both question and answer text, rendering results without navigation or auth requirements.

requirements.summary: Refactor FAQ content into a structured in-component data model and render from that model.
acceptanceCriteria: FAQ sections and Q/A content remain exactly the same as before when no search is applied (including the support email and mailto link).
Filtering is applied based on the data model and the UI is rendered from that model (no hardcoded duplicated Q/A blocks for filtered vs unfiltered states).

file_operations.description: Convert the current static markup into an in-component data structure (sections with items containing question/answer strings and any needed rendering metadata) and render the full FAQ UI from this model so the same rendering path supports both filtered and unfiltered views while preserving existing text and the support mailto link.

requirements.summary: Add empty-state UI for no matching results with a one-click clear action.
acceptanceCriteria: If the query returns zero matches, the page shows a friendly English message such as “No results found” within the FAQ card content area.
A clear action is available (e.g., a clear button) that resets the query to empty and restores all FAQ content.
Clearing the query restores the original section ordering and all entries.

file_operations.description: When filtering yields zero items, show an in-card empty-state message (e.g., “No results found”) and provide a clear/reset control that sets the query back to empty and restores the original section ordering and full FAQ list.

requirements.summary: Style the search UI to match the existing FAQ page visual system and ensure accessibility/responsiveness.
acceptanceCriteria: Search input styling is consistent with the app’s Tailwind/shadcn look-and-feel on the FAQ page (no unstyled default input).
Search control has an accessible label (visible or aria-label) and reasonable focus styles.
The search bar does not break the current responsive layout of the FAQ page.

file_operations.description: Add a styled search control placed under the title/intro using the existing Card/Tailwind styling patterns and amber accents already used on the page; ensure an accessible label/aria-label, visible focus styles, and a responsive layout that preserves the current spacing/typography.
